title: New law: Lilly Ledbetter Fair Pay Act of 2009 (Public Law 111-2)
summary: S. 181 of the 111th Congress became Public Law 111-2 on 2009-01-29.

title: New law: A joint resolution ensuring that the compensation and other emoluments attached to the office of Secretary of the Interior are those which were in effect on January 1, 2005. (Public Law 111-1)
summary: S.J.Res. 3 of the 111th Congress became Public Law 111-1 on 2009-01-16.
